name: TC-732: walk-in seat → SEATED; the first check on the table inherits the seat time and guest count
description: POST /tables/:id/seat {guestCount:3} → 200, floor SEATED with `seatedWalkIn`. Opening a check there WITHOUT a guestCount consumes the seat: the order carries guestCount 3 and seatedAt = the seat time; the floor reads OCCUPIED with no walk-in left.
